title: What Changed Between Claude Opus 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.6?
author: Rayan Pal
request_serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon
fresh_context: exactly one user message per request; system only where specified
dispatch: pending slots dispatched in schedule order to concurrency workers; each slot's attempts and retries stay on one worker; events appended to one hash chain under a lock
schedule_algorithm: rows = conditions x replicates in frozen order; Python random.Random(seed).shuffle(rows); saved schedule is authoritative

preflight.pass: HTTP 200, well-formed message, returned model equals requested model, response id begins msg_, request-id header present
preflight.required_before_run: frozen preflight PASS on the same commit

retry.wait: HTTP 429 or 5xx with a retry-after header: min(ceil(value), 120) seconds; otherwise backoff_seconds

spend.scope: per experiment output folder, cumulative across resumes
spend.reservation: max_tokens x output price + 2000 x input price, before each dispatch
spend.cap_rule: if spent + reservation > max_spend_usd: PAUSED, reason spend cap, no dispatch

settlement.2xx without usage, transport error, inte: reservation kept as spent; never released

spend.usage_cost: (input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens) x input price + output_tokens x output price
spend.cost_envelope_basis: sum of reservations over every scheduled request

statuses.COMPLETE: every scheduled slot has exactly one definitive record
statuses.PAUSED: spend cap, provider quota (QE) or interrupted; resumable

resume: replay and verify the event chain, skip slots with a definitive record, continue from the first slot without one, append to events.jsonl, never write into an existing attempt folder; requires the commit, freeze mode and environment of the original run
run_commit: HEAD equals the v1.0.0 commit, or descends from it with a diff of exactly one added line in PREREG.md

stop_rules.existing_output: resume if not COMPLETE or INCONCLUSIVE; otherwise refuse

void.V0: Successful provider response; text container present; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; recognized normal stop
void.V1: Successful provider response; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; recognized output-budget stop
void.V2: Successful provider response; text container absent; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; recognized normal stop
void.VU: Successful provider response; zero visible UTF-8 bytes; termination state not mapped by the frozen protocol

taxonomy.void_status: All four classes retain Void status. Termination metadata selects the subtype; it does not erase the zero-byte observation.

non_void.NV: Nonempty near-Void output, including whitespace, invisible code points, or ellipsis forms
non_void.BE: Non-successful provider response reporting an output-budget error
non_void.E: Transport, rate-limit, server, non-JSON, or infrastructure failure after configured retry handling

cross_script.T1: Visible text exactly equal to شָׁרְט (UTF-8 d8b4d6b8d781d7a8d6b0d798)
cross_script.T0: Visible text exactly equal to شָרְט (UTF-8 d8b4d6b8d7a8d6b0d798)
cross_script.HE: Visible text exactly equal to שָׁרְט (UTF-8 d7a9d6b8d781d7a8d6b0d798)
cross_script.SHART: Visible text exactly equal to شَرْط (UTF-8 d8b4d98ed8b1d992d8b7)
cross_script.SHAMS: Visible text exactly equal to شَمْس (UTF-8 d8b4d98ed985d992d8b3)
cross_script.MX: Nonempty visible text, not an exact target, containing at least one Unicode Script=Arabic and one Script=Hebrew code point (pinned regex)
cross_script.OT: All remaining nonempty visible text, including whitespace-only and invisible-only text

taxonomy.visible_text: concatenation of all text blocks in response order; absent text blocks yield an absent text container

markers: max_tokens or model output limit was reached
you have reached your specified workspace api usage limits
you have reached your specified api usage limits
you have reached your api usage limits

http_errors.E: all other non-2xx statuses and transport failures

taxonomy.exp3_descriptors: contains (substring presence of each exact target), mixed_script_words (letter-and-mark runs containing both Script=Arabic and Script=Hebrew)
taxonomy.normalization: none; whitespace and invisible code points are nonempty

event_hash: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON excluding event_hash; first prev_hash 64 zeroes
